A real person replies.

Email fabricationintelligence@gmail.com and one of the founders answers, usually within 48 hours. We deal with the supplier for you, so you do not need to chase them yourself.

1. Contact us

EmailOrders, deliveries, returns and anything else.fabricationintelligence@gmail.com Contact formProduct questions, trade prices and quotes for bigger jobs.contact.html Report a bugSomething on the website is broken or confusing.bug-report.html

2. Help with an order

Email us with your order number (it is in your confirmation email) and tell us what you need. Common cases:

You want toWhat happens
Know where your parcel isWe send the tracking number once the supplier gives it to us. If it has been more than three weeks, email us and we chase the supplier.
Change your addressEmail as soon as you can. We can change it only if the supplier has not shipped yet.
Cancel an orderEmail as soon as you can. See cancellation and change of mind.
Report a fault or wrong itemSend photos and your order number. See returns and refunds.
Ask about a refundWe confirm the amount and the payment method it goes back to. Banks can take a few days to show it.

3. Before you write

  • Read the Something wrong? table in the docs. Most problems have a quick answer there.
  • Have your order number and the email address you used ready.
  • For a fault, take clear photos of the item, the packaging and the label.
  • Do not keep using or installing anything that looks unsafe.

4. Staying safe

We will never ask you for your password, a full card number or a verification code by email, message or phone. If someone claiming to be FI does, do not reply, and forward it to us. Payments are made only on the secure checkout, never by bank transfer to a person.

5. Your rights

Australian Consumer Law gives you guarantees about the goods you buy, including that they are of acceptable quality and match their description. These apply no matter what any page on this site says. If we cannot sort a problem out, you can contact your state or territory consumer protection agency. Read returns and refunds and the legal hub for more.

6. Other ways to reach us

Makers and suppliers can start on the partner page. People who want to join the team can use Work with us. Tell us what you think of the site on the feedback page.
